channel.title: The Real News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Real News (therealnews.com)

item.title: Number of children in ICE detention skyrockets under Trump
item.description: The daily number of kids in ICE cages has increased sixfold under the second Trump administration, according to new reporting from the Marshall Project.

item.title: Pípsell: The last stand (Documentary)
item.description: In their new feature documentary, Pípsell: The Last Stand, award-winning journalist Brandi Morin and filmmaker Geordie Day expose the human and environmental costs of Canada's TMX pipeline.

item.title: These women exposed prison sexual abuse. Now ICE wants to deport them.
item.description: Federal protections against detention and deportation for sexual abuse survivors have deteriorated under Trump.

item.title: Afghanistan War vet blasts Trump’s ‘pathetic and horrific’ war with Iran
item.description: “They called Afghanistan ‘the place where empires go to die,’ and Iran is very similar in that terrain. You put boots on the ground in Iran, and we're in for a lot of pain.”

item.title: While spending billions on Iran war, Trump quietly moves to boot millions more off food aid
item.description: “Americans can’t afford their groceries, they can’t afford their medicine, they can’t afford the cost of living, and yet we’re dropping a billion dollars of bombs, it seems, every day in Iran,” said one Senate Democrat.

item.title: US military aid to Israel is a national security risk
item.description: We have another report that Israel used the military power the US underwrites to pressure Donald Trump into a disastrous war in Iran. US military aid to Israel makes Americans — to say nothing of the rest of the world — less safe.

item.title: As opposition to Iran war grows, US media ramps up ‘Iranian sleeper cell’ panic
item.description: How to bring the war home to an increasingly war-weary public? Tell them terrorists are “hiding in plain sight.”

item.title: ‘Worst of the worst’? ICE snatches beloved video gaming champion living in US legally for decades
item.description: “This is the nightmare that I've had—literally had nightmares woken up in a cold sweat about. The government has kidnapped one of my friends."

item.title: This fall, Florida students will be forced to take ‘anti-communist’ classes
item.description: Florida public schools will force students to take a Heritage Foundation-backed class on the “evils of communism.”

item.title: The Donroe Coalition: Trump’s new right-wing military alliance | Under the Shadow S2E8
item.description: Last weekend, Donald Trump met with right-wing allies from Latin America to kick off a new military coalition to attack so-called drug cartels and push his agenda up and down the hemisphere. This is episode 8 of Under the Shadow, Season 2.
